offer.text: Install Riders on your phone to open it full screen and use it offline.

ios.title: Install Riders on your iPhone
ios.stepShare: Tap the Share button in Safari.

firstOpenOffline.title: Riders needs a connection the first time
firstOpenOffline.body: Connect to the internet and open the app again. After that first time, Riders will open even without a connection.

map.unavailableOffline: This area of the map is not available offline.
map.incompleteRegion: The area “{{name}}” is incomplete: showing what was downloaded so far.

sources.title: Map data sources
sources.openStreetMap: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
sources.openFreeMap: Tile service and map style provided by OpenFreeMap.

location.why: Riders uses your location only to show you on the map.

denied.title: Your position cannot be shown
denied.howTo: Location permission is denied. To enable it, open your phone settings, find the permissions for Riders (or for the browser you open it with) and allow access to location.

empty.title: You have not downloaded any area yet
empty.body: Downloading an area lets you see its map when you have no connection, for example on the road. To do it, move and zoom the map until you see the area you want to take with you, come back to this screen and tap “Download the area visible on the map”.

download.start: Download the area visible on the map
download.name: Area name
download.tooLarge_one: The visible area is too large to download. Zoom the map in {{count}} level and try again.
download.tooLarge_other: The visible area is too large to download. Zoom the map in {{count}} levels and try again.
download.insufficientSpace: There is not enough space on the phone: the area would take about {{estimated}} and {{available}} are available.

paused.connectivity: Paused: no connection. The download resumes by itself when the connection is back.
paused.storage-full: Paused: there is no space left on the phone.

region.incomplete: Incomplete area: offline you only see what was downloaded so far.
region.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}”? Its map will no longer be available offline.

storageWarning.text: Your phone storage is running out. Your downloaded areas take up {{size}}. You can delete the ones you no longer need; Riders does not delete anything by itself.

riderAccount.signInFailed: Sign-in did not complete. You can try again.

completeProfile.title: Complete your profile
completeProfile.intro: So other Riders can recognize you, choose your display name, build your avatar and add your motorcycle.

displayName.tooShort: The name needs at least 2 characters.
displayName.tooLong: The name can have up to 24 characters.

model.tooShort: The make and model need at least 2 characters.
model.tooLong: The make and model can have up to 40 characters.

rangeKm.notANumber: The range must be a number.
rangeKm.notAnInteger: The range must be a whole number, without decimals.
